# Test mod for triggering "unknown effect" errors
# These effect names are intentionally made up to trigger error messages

namespace = re_unknown_effect

re_unknown_effect.0001 = {
	type = character_event
	title = re_unknown_effect.0001.t
	desc = re_unknown_effect.0001.desc

	trigger = {
		is_alive = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		# INTENTIONAL: Made-up effect names to trigger registry lookup errors
		this_effect_does_not_exist_at_all = yes
		completely_fake_effect_name = yes
		add_nonexistent_resource = 100
		remove_fake_modifier = yes
		set_imaginary_flag = yes

		# Fake scoped effects
		random_fake_scope = {
			limit = {
				is_alive = yes
			}
			another_fake_nested_effect = yes
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = re_unknown_effect.0001.a

		# Effects in options
		trigger_nonexistent_event = {
			id = fake.9999
		}

		give_fake_claim = {
			target = root
		}
	}
}

re_unknown_effect.0002 = {
	type = character_event
	title = re_unknown_effect.0002.t
	desc = re_unknown_effect.0002.desc

	trigger = {
		is_alive = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		# Test variations of effect patterns
		xyzzy_random_effect = yes
		test_numbered_effect_99 = yes
		UPPERCASE_EFFECT = yes
		MixedCase_Effect = yes

		# Hidden effect with fakes
		hidden_effect = {
			fake_hidden_effect_1 = yes
			fake_hidden_effect_2 = {
				target = root
				value = 50
			}
		}

		# Show as tooltip with fakes
		show_as_tooltip = {
			fake_tooltip_effect = yes
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = re_unknown_effect.0002.a
		# Valid effect for comparison
		add_gold = 100
		# Invalid effect
		add_platinum = 100
	}
}
